**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **Grant clauses (§§ 2.1–2.4):** licences run to Corio only. "Affiliate" appears nowhere in the Agreement, and there is no notice mechanism to add one — the fallback element of affiliate coverage on written notice fails materially.
- **Successor transfer:** already met — the grants are "nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1)", and § 14.1 permits assignment on merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all related assets without consent. The direct-competitor consent carve-out is noted only, not flagged.
- **Not flagged:** § 2.1 is expressly perpetual and irrevocable, § 2.2 is fully paid up and perpetual, § 11.2 limits termination to uncured material breach, and § 11.3 preserves Customer access post-termination — no walk-away revocability risk.
- **Cure:** one inserted § 2.11 extending the Section 2 licences to Corio's affiliates on written notice; no other text touched.
